---
name: Feature Request
about: Suggest an improvement or new feature
title: "[FEATURE] "
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

## Feature Description

Clearly describe the feature or improvement you would like to see.

## Problem

What problem does this feature solve?

## Proposed Solution

Describe how you think the feature should work.

## Expected Behavior

Explain what the user should be able to do after this feature is implemented.

## Alternatives

Describe any alternative solutions you considered.

## Additional Information

Add screenshots, examples, references, or other useful information here.

## Checklist

- [ ] I searched existing issues before creating this request.
- [ ] This feature is related to the project.
- [ ] I have clearly explained the expected behavior.
